entities.summary: Léonie Geisendorf, born Leonia Maria Kolin-Kaplan, was a Polish-born, Swedish architect. She lived most of her professional life in Stockholm, Sweden. At the time of her death, she was living in Paris, France. Notable works include St. Görans Gymnasium in Stockholm.
